_comment: Preset lint error BUDGET for tests/release/release_gate.py gate 5 (preset-lint-budget, see tests/release/preset_lint_budget.py). 'preset_lint_error_budget' is the maximum number of src.features.presets.linter.PresetLinter ERRORS (never warnings) allowed repo-wide, across content/presets/marketplace/ and content/presets/local/, before the release gate fails. It is a burn-down ceiling, not a permanent allowance: the repo lints clean today (0 errors), so the budget is seeded at 0. If it's ever nonzero because new errors landed and can't be fixed immediately, lower it back toward 0 as each one is fixed - do NOT raise this number just to make a red gate green without also filing a tracked follow-up to fix the underlying preset(s); that defeats the entire point of having a budget. Independent of this number, every preset referenced by a content/recipes/{marketplace,local}/*.yml file's presets: list (via path_hint) must ALWAYS lint with zero errors - that check is hard and non-negotiable, and this budget can never excuse it.
